author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
It took me a few minutes to generate 30 pages of slides using AI, and the slides even come with fancy AI generated pictures that look pretty cool.

It took me 3 hours to hand craft 3 slides from the same source materials, just old fashion bullet points plain text.

That is the gap between AI and human. AI couldn't get me the 3 slides of plain text that actually matters in the meeting.
